text:
Acci-Claim (MACT)
Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (MACT) for filing accident compensation claims. Use this if you were injured in a road accident or vehicle collision and want to claim insurance or compensation.

Antique FIR
File an FIR for theft or loss of antique items, heritage objects, or valuable artifacts.

CGHS Empanelled Hospital
List of CGHS empanelled hospitals for Delhi Police personnel and their families for medical treatment.

Character Verification Report
Apply for a Character Verification Report (CVR) required for employment, visa, tenant verification, or background checks. Confirms a person has no criminal record.
Steps:
- Open the PCC & CVR portal
- Register as "Character Verification Report": fill Organisation Name, Mobile, Email, Password and Captcha
- Receive and enter the OTP
- Log in
- Click "Apply New"
- Select Government Employee
- Verifier details (organisation name, address, contact) are auto-filled from registration — confirm them
- Fill applicant details
- Fill educational details
- Fill present address; add up to 5 previous Delhi addresses if applicable
- Fill criminal case details if any (up to 10 cases)
- Upload the 5 documents listed above
- Review the form preview
- Accept the two consent checkboxes
- Click "Submit"
- You will receive a CVR number — application enters "Under Verification" status
- The certificate becomes available for download once approved
Required documents:
- Applicant's Photo — JPEG, JPG or PNG, under 20 KB
- 10th Certificate or Marksheet — PDF / JPEG / JPG / PNG, under 200 KB
- Photo Identity Proof — PDF / JPEG / JPG / PNG, under 200 KB
- Residential Address Proof — PDF / JPEG / JPG / PNG, under 200 KB
- Forwarding Letter — PDF / JPEG / JPG / PNG, under 200 KB

Circulars / Orders / Notifications
View official circulars, orders and notifications issued by Delhi Police.

Citizen Services Feedback
Submit feedback about Delhi Police citizen services. Rate and review the services you have used.

Complaint Dashboard
View and track the status of your complaints filed with Delhi Police. Check progress of grievances.

Complaint Lodging
File an online complaint or grievance with Delhi Police. Lodge complaints about crimes, harassment, or any police matter.

Conviction/ Involvement
Check criminal conviction or involvement records of a person. Used for background verification and tenant checks.

Court Ruling
View important court rulings and judgments related to Delhi Police cases.

Delhi Police Retired Talent
Portal for retired Delhi Police personnel to register their skills and find post-retirement opportunities.

Domestic Help/Tenant Registration
Register your domestic help (maid, cook, driver, guard) or tenant with Delhi Police for background verification and safety. Mandatory for landlords.

Dossier
Access and manage police dossiers and records for official use.

Download Forms
Download official Delhi Police forms for applications including NOC, license, character certificate, tenant registration, event permission, and more.

Economic Offences Wing (EOW)
Report economic crimes such as fraud, cheating, financial scams, ponzi schemes, investment fraud, or corporate fraud to the Economic Offences Wing.

FSL
Forensic Science Laboratory (FSL) portal for submitting and tracking forensic evidence requests related to crime cases.

Go's Mess Accommodation & Tariff
Information about Guest Officer's Mess accommodation and tariff for Delhi Police officers.

Lost Report
File a report for any lost item such as mobile phone, wallet, documents, keys, purse, ID card, or any personal belonging. Get a police acknowledgment for lost items.
Steps:
- Access the Delhi Police Lost & Found portal and select "Lost Article Report" → click "Register"
- Enter personal info: Complainant Name, Parent's Name, Address and Email ID
- Fill event details: Place of Loss, Date of Loss and Time of Loss (must be within Delhi)
- Choose item type from the "Lost Articles" dropdown, add description / serial number and click "ADD". Repeat for multiple items
- Solve the alphanumeric CAPTCHA and click "Submit"
- A "Record Saved Successfully" confirmation appears. A digitally verifiable PDF is generated, downloaded to your device and emailed to you

Missing Person/Children Registration (Helpline No.-1094)
Register a missing person or missing child with Delhi Police. Use this if a family member, child, elderly person or anyone is missing and cannot be found. Also covers missing women, men and teenagers. Missing Persons Helpline - 1094

Missing Person Search (Helpline No.-1094)
Search the database of missing persons reported to Delhi Police. Look up if a missing person has been found or identified.

Missing / Stolen Mobile Phones
Search for missing or stolen mobile phones in the Delhi Police database. Check if your stolen phone has been recovered.

MV Theft E FIR
File an online e-FIR for motor vehicle theft. Use this if your car, bike, scooter, or any vehicle has been stolen.
Steps:
- Open the Delhi Police MV Theft portal
- Click "NEW USER" and register with Name, Email and Mobile Number
- Enter the 4-digit OTP sent to your device (valid for 2 hours)
- On your dashboard, click the "Register FIR" tile
- Step A — Complainant Details: enter name, address, time window, and the exact Delhi location of the theft
- Step B — Vehicle Details: enter Registration Number; Engine No., Chassis No., Make, Model and Colour are auto-populated from the national vehicle registry
- Step C — Property Stolen: use the "+" button to append personal items stolen from inside the vehicle
- Step D — Other Details: upload your ID proof and describe any suspected individuals if known
- Review the PREVIEW draft, click "Submit", and tick the ROAC checkbox to authorise registration
- Download your digitally signed FIR. Your case is routed to an Investigating Officer; alerts are sent to NCRB, SCRB and State Transport Authorities
Required documents:
- Complainant ID Proof — Aadhaar Card, Passport, PAN Card, Driving Licence, or Election ID; PDF / JPEG / JPG / PNG, under 200 KB
- Property Details — list of personal items left inside the vehicle (laptops, wallets, baggage) for the secondary theft itemizer

NOC / License
Apply for No Objection Certificate (NOC) or police license for arms, explosives, hotels, restaurants, events, or other regulated activities.

Pak National Registration Guidelines
Guidelines for registration of Pakistani nationals visiting or residing in India.

document_title: Permission for Procession, Rallies & Other Events
text:
Permission for Procession, Rallies & Other Events
Apply for police permission to hold processions, rallies, protests, public gatherings, concerts, or any public events in Delhi.

PMS/VMS
Prison Management System and Visitor Management System for managing prison records and visitor tracking.

Police Clearance Certificate
Apply for Police Clearance Certificate (PCC) required for visa, immigration, passport, overseas employment, or foreign travel. Proves you have no criminal record.
Steps:
- Open the PCC & CVR portal
- Register: enter name, mobile, email, password and captcha
- Receive and enter the OTP
- Log in
- Click "Apply New"
- Select Individual or Organisation
- Select the PCC type and verification mode
- Fill your present address; add up to 5 previous Delhi addresses if applicable
- Fill criminal case details if any (up to 10 cases; multiple states allowed)
- Upload the 4 documents listed above
- Review the form preview and edit if needed
- Accept the two consent checkboxes
- Click "Pay and Submit" and complete payment
- You will receive a PCC number — application enters "Under Verification" status
- Download the certificate once it is approved
Required documents:
- Applicant's Photo / Firm Logo — JPEG, JPG or PNG, under 20 KB
- Photo Identity Proof / Registration Certificate — PDF / JPEG / JPG / PNG, under 200 KB (PAN Card, Driving Licence, Election ID, or Aadhaar Card)
- Residential Address Proof — PDF / JPEG / JPG / PNG, under 200 KB (Aadhaar, Bank Passbook, Driving Licence, Election ID, Passport, Electricity Bill, Telephone Bill, Ration Card, or Rent Agreement)
- Forwarding Letter from Govt / PSU / Semi-Govt / Others — PDF / JPEG / JPG / PNG, under 200 KB

Prison Management System (PMS)
Access the Prison Management System to check prisoner records, case status, and prison information.

Quarter Allotment Cell
Delhi Police quarter and housing allotment portal for police personnel to apply for official accommodation.

Request for 66 DP Act
Submit a request under Section 66 of the Delhi Police Act for police services.

Request for Jamatalashi/Supardari Claims
Apply for Jamatalashi (body search) or Supardari (custody release of vehicle/property) claims with Delhi Police.

Retired DP Personnel form
Form for retired Delhi Police personnel for benefits, records, and post-retirement services.

RTI
File a Right to Information (RTI) application with Delhi Police to request official information or records.

Senior Citizens Registration
Register senior citizens (elderly persons above 60) with Delhi Police for safety, welfare checks, and emergency assistance.

Sexual Harassment at Workplace
Report sexual harassment at workplace under POSH Act. File complaint against sexual harassment, misconduct or inappropriate behavior at office or workplace.

Stolen Vehicles Search
Search the database of stolen vehicles in Delhi. Check if your stolen car, bike, or vehicle has been recovered by police.

Theft e FIR
File an online e-FIR for theft of property, mobile phone, wallet, documents, or any personal belongings. Use this if something was stolen from you.

document_title: Track The Missing Child (Mission Vatsalya), (Helpline No.-1094)
text:
Track The Missing Child (Mission Vatsalya), (Helpline No.-1094)
Track a missing child through Mission Vatsalya portal. This government initiative helps locate and reunite missing children with their families.

Un-Identified Dead Bodies
Search database of unidentified dead bodies found in Delhi. Use this to identify a deceased family member or unknown person found dead.

Un-Identified Persons Found
Search database of unidentified persons found in Delhi. If a missing family member may have been found but not yet identified, search here.

Unclaimed/ Seized Vehicle Search
Search for unclaimed or seized vehicles in Delhi Police custody. Check if your vehicle has been towed or seized.

View Complaint Status
Check and track the current status of your complaint filed with Delhi Police. See if your complaint is being processed.

View FIR
View or download a copy of your FIR (First Information Report) filed with Delhi Police.

ZIP NET
ZIPNET is Delhi Police's integrated database for searching stolen vehicles, missing mobiles, missing persons, unidentified bodies, and seized vehicles.

document_title: SPUWAC - Special Police Unit for Women and Children
text:
SPUWAC - Special Police Unit for Women and Children
The Delhi Police SPUWAC portal is a specialized digital gateway offering emergency assistance, complaint lodging, mediation, and self-defense training to protect women, children, and senior citizens.
